acceptance_criteria.description: Mirror readiness reports canonical and accelerated sources without credential values or authenticated URLs.
OCI acquisition pulls only immutable source digests, verifies manifest, config, layers, and platform, and retags canonical references only after all checks pass.
Successful acquisition emits a standalone receipt with observed Docker identity and content digests; failures emit no success receipt and preserve a retryable boundary.
Implementation, fixtures, tests, and documentation do not change BMP schemas, runner semantics, execution registries, or benchmark result claims.

objective: Make Git, Python, and OCI mirror use repeatable and secret-safe, with OCI pulls bound to manifest, platform, and config identity before canonical retagging.
title: Add digest-bound mirror acquisition tooling
